text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to recognise the risks that could affect your project or business. Once you know them, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or stop them from occurring. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup actions you can take if things go wrong. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. By following these steps, you can protect your goals and make better decisions, even when the future is uncertain.
